customer_concentration.note: End customers are consumers; no customer concentration. FY2025 10-K: Apple App Store 61.6%, Google Play 23.4%, Stripe 10.3% of revenue processed (payment/distribution platforms, not customers)

notes: Revenue is from XBRL; Q4 values are FY minus 9M. Growth has slowed sharply: Q2'26 +18% YoY, Q3'26 guide 302 (+11.1% YoY, +1.2% QoQ), FY26 guide 15-18% revenue and 10-12% bookings (reaffirmed). Management is deliberately prioritizing DAU growth (+23%) over monetization. Gross margin is GAAP 72.6% (no non-GAAP GM). No adjusted operating margin is reported (adjusted EBITDA margin 25.9%), so the scorer uses GAAP 11.4%. TTM (Q3'25-Q2'26): OCF 430.5, capex 33.0 (PP&E + capitalized software), FCF 397.5 on revenue 1,145.0. Net cash = cash 1,180.9 + short-term investments 133.0 + long-term investments 102.7 at 6/30/26; no debt; operating leases excluded. ttm_pe/eps_growth (judgment call): Duolingo reports no adjusted EPS, and GAAP TTM EPS (~$8.4, P/E ~17) is inflated by the one-time $256.7M valuation-allowance release in Q3/Q4'25. Adjusted TTM EPS = GAAP less that benefit: Q3'25 (292.2-222.7)/49.1M = 1.41, Q4'25 (42.0-34.0)/49.1M = 0.16 (Q3 diluted share count used as proxy), Q1'26 0.89, Q2'26 0.66, total ~3.12. Prior TTM GAAP EPS 0.49+0.31 (Q4'24 derived FY 1.88 - 9M 1.57)+0.72+0.91 = 2.43. Prior-TTM earnings carried almost no tax (valuation allowance), so the growth rate understates pre-tax growth. NRR is not disclosed. Price $144.27 at the 2026-10-02 close.
